claims.text: The authoritative generator deterministically emits duplicate-free directed graphs with exactly min(kN,N^2) edges, one self edge and exact receiver degree min(k,N).
claims.permitted_inference: implemented generator over validated positive integer inputs
claims.falsifier: any admitted input produces the wrong count or receiver degree, a duplicate, missing self edge, out-of-range endpoint, nondeterministic repeat, or wrong saturation
claims.uncertainty: the topology is receiver-regular synthetic structure, not a domain neighbor distribution
claims.next_action: add separate topology families only under a new registered scaling packet

claims.text: Every authoritative N-by-k cell passes one identical prevalidated edge tensor to EC-LGL and private static EGNN, with fixed recorded model initialization and edge construction outside synchronized model timing.
claims.permitted_inference: the saved benchmark implementation and 24-cell CUDA execution
claims.falsifier: a cell uses distinct edge tensors, times graph construction, omits a model result, or silently drops an admitted cell
claims.uncertainty: same edge tensor does not mean the two model equations perform identical computation
claims.next_action: retain explicit same-edge and different-computation labels

claims.text: On the recorded RTX PRO 6000 FP32 forward workload with model seed fixed at 20260723, EC-LGL first crosses private static EGNN at N=8192,k=64 and is faster for all three confirmed graph seeds at k=64 and k=128.
claims.permitted_inference: this hardware, software state, model widths, one-graph workload, registered sizes and synchronized inference protocol
claims.falsifier: any confirmed k=64 seed has EC-LGL/EGNN median ratio at least one, the edge hashes do not correspond to exact-degree graphs, or timing lacks synchronization
claims.uncertainty: the k=64 margin is only 1.2-1.6%; crossover location is hardware, implementation, dtype and shape dependent
claims.next_action: treat k=128 as the robust win and remeasure k=64 after any kernel or environment change

claims.text: Optimizing only one scatter kernel is sufficient to make EC-LGL competitive across sparse and dense regimes.
claims.permitted_inference: none; this candidate conclusion is tested and rejected for the current evidence
claims.falsifier: not applicable to an unsupported sufficiency claim
claims.uncertainty: profiling identifies distributed costs but does not quantify the speedup from a future fused implementation
claims.next_action: separately target fixed/O(N) overhead, edge temporaries, accuracy stability and neighbor construction

claims.text: The synthetic forward crossover establishes better molecule, protein or generic 3D point-cloud accuracy or end-to-end throughput.
claims.falsifier: not applicable because no domain superiority claim is admitted
claims.uncertainty: graph construction, batching, backward, chirality, forces and domain transfer were not measured
claims.next_action: run separate domain-specific, split-aware accuracy and end-to-end systems packets
